v1_definition: V1 requires a listen-only vehicle gateway and at least one physical gauge that show validated data, stale states, and warnings without affecting vehicle operation.

milestones.name: Telemetry and safety core
milestones.description: CAN abstraction, J1939 parsing, normalized signals, cache behavior, alarms, and diagnostics have broad host-test coverage.
milestones.next_gate: Complete the remaining reviewed contracts and target-facing safety composition.

milestones.name: Gauge logic and recovery
milestones.description: Display-neutral view models, trends, configuration records, and recovery behavior exist without a finished physical renderer.
milestones.next_gate: Bind the view model, input, storage, and recovery behavior to a selected display target.

milestones.name: Vehicle gateway firmware
milestones.description: The bounded gateway path exists in components; target adapters, protected hardware, wiring, and passive vehicle proof remain.
milestones.next_gate: Select the gateway hardware and prove passive target operation on authorized vehicle data.

milestones.name: Round-display firmware
milestones.description: The planned compact gauge experience and display-neutral model are defined, but no physical renderer, touch target, or candidate display has been validated.
milestones.next_gate: Receive and characterize the selected display, then run native gauge firmware on it.

milestones.name: OpenTrail alert bridge
milestones.description: Normalized alert and acknowledgement contracts have host and limited three-radio bench evidence across both projects.
milestones.next_gate: Bind authenticated target transport and prove restart-safe physical delivery.

milestones.name: Vehicle and field validation
milestones.description: No specific vehicle, production power path, physical gauge, interruption test, or road-use result is currently supported.
milestones.next_gate: Pass the frozen gateway and gauge acceptance plan on real hardware and an authorized vehicle.

change_log.reason: Established the first evidence-weighted V1 baseline for public progress reporting.
